investigator.note: I prioritised industrial accidents, gas leaks, fires, and chemical spills alongside extreme rainfall and floods due to Manali's concentration of heavy industries—highlighted by the 2023 CPCL oil spill, 2025 Bio-CNG plant explosion, and recurring refinery fires—and its historical monsoon flooding. For industrial and fire hazards, I evaluated chemical exposure (`get_industrial_exposure`), emergency care walking distances (`get_access('hospital')`), fire response reach (`get_access('fire_station')`), and veterinary readiness (`get_animal_facilities`). For flood and environmental risks, I checked low-lying block exposure (`get_flood_exposure`), vertical refuge access (`get_access('flood_refuge')`), and wetland and water body trends (`get_nature_change`).

report.summary: Manali faces heavy risk from industrial hazards, fires, chemical spills, and severe monsoonal flooding given its dense concentration of industrial sites like CPCL Refinery and low-lying topography. Readiness is currently low with zero fire stations or veterinary facilities within 2 km and limited access to hospitals and vertical flood refuges. Emergency response infrastructure and flood shelters must be immediately established near high-risk industrial and low-lying residential sectors.

calamities.what_happened: Oil from the CPCL refinery premises in Manali flowed into the Buckingham Canal and Ennore Creek during the Michaung floods.
A worker was killed and another injured in a fatal explosion triggered by a suspected gas leak inside the control room of a Bio-CNG plant on Manali Main Road.
A fire erupted at the Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited (CPCL) refinery complex in Manali, sending heavy smoke into the air before being brought under control.
A naphtha leak in a pump transferred at the CPCL refinery in Manali triggered a fire at a crude oil distillation unit that was contained after two hours.

Satellite (MODIS) saw flood water on about 3 pixels of 250 m (not counting permanent water) in this area during Global Flood Database event 2758 (2005-10-23 to 2005-12-09; main cause: Monsoonal rain; reported deaths 279, displaced 300000 for the whole event).
218 mm of rain in one day at this location (CHIRPS satellite-gauge estimate).

readiness.why_it_matters_here: There are 300 industrial sites within 4200 m including CPCL Refinery, Manali Fertilizers Limited - MFL, and Manali Petro Chemicals, posing high fire and chemical leak risks.

matrix.finding: 12 industrial sites exist in the area, but only 1.1% of residents are within 1000m of a major hospital and median walk distance to a hospital is 2973 m.
0.0% of residents have a fire station within 2000m; median walk distance to a fire station is 8894 m (reaching up to 10901 m in worst blocks).
0.0% of residents have access to a vet or animal shelter within 2000m, with median walk distance to a vet at 11154 m.
Built area expanded from 68.1% in 2016 to 73.4% in 2025, while tree cover declined from 9.9% to 7.7%.

readiness.why_it_matters_here: Area has 7 low-lying blocks housing 6014 residents, with 13 days of very heavy rainfall (>115.6 mm) between 2001 and 2025.

matrix.finding: 7 low-lying blocks hold 6014 residents; 5001 residents across 6 flood-prone blocks lack a vertical flood refuge within 300m walk.
0.0% of residents have access to a tall building flood refuge within 2000m, with median walk distance being 4172 m.
Flooded vegetation decreased from 4.1% in 2016 to 0.5% in 2025, indicating degradation of natural wetland buffers.

recommendations.what: Establish an emergency response station with dedicated fire and chemical hazmat capacity.
recommendations.why: 0.0% of residents are within 2000m of a fire station, with median walk distance at 8894 m and up to 10901 m in worst blocks (hex 89618eb3037ffff), despite 300 industrial sites within 4200 m.

recommendations.what: Construct dedicated vertical flood refuges and storm shelters.
recommendations.why: 5001 residents across 6 flood-prone blocks lack vertical refuge within 300m, and overall 0.0% of residents have vertical refuges within 2000m (median walk distance 4172 m).

recommendations.what: Expand emergency trauma and clinical healthcare facilities.
recommendations.why: Only 1.1% of residents are within 1000m walk of a hospital, with median walk distance being 2973 m (up to 4251 m in hex 89618eb3097ffff).
